RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 40

An all-male panel can signal subtle affinity bias or a procedural failure, though on its own it does not prove sex discrimination. The appointee held valid qualifications and specific international project experience that may have aligned closely with the role.

First, follow up on your requested written debrief and request your competency scores. Simultaneously, check whether civil service recruitment policy mandates diverse or balanced panels. Only raise the panel's composition if there was an explicit procedural breach or if the written feedback shows unjustified, subjective scoring. In that case, raise it through official HR channels or your union, rather than directly accusing the panel.
